services.name: School Programs
services.desc: We're proud to host you on Coronado's premier walking tour. Every tour purchase supports the Coronado Historical Association and its mission. Thank you for your support. Tours are approximately 60 minutes and three-quarters of a mile at a comfortable pace. They are appropriate for young and old, alike. Only certified service animals are allowed. This is an outdoor tour. Masks are optional. Participants enjoy a 10% discount at the Coronado Historical Association Store (1100 Orange Ave). CancellationTickets are non-refundable. services.name: Past Exhibits
services.desc: Presented as part of the nationwide America250 commemoration and sponsored locally by the Coronado Community Foundation and the City of Coronado, Moments That Made US explores how generations of Americans have given meaning to the principles outlined in the Declaration of Independence. Organized around five themes drawn directly from the Declaration-Created Equal; Life, Liberty, and the Pursuit of Happiness; Free and Independent States; Consent of the Governed; and We Mutually Pledge to Each Other-the exhibit examines pivotal moments from the colonial era to the present, highlighting both the triumphs and challenges that have shaped the nation. Developed through a multi-state collaboration
